zh-TW: 歸屬於母公司業主之權益報酬率（CIAS）
en: Return on equity attributable to owners of the parent

note.zh-TW: 模板標題是「歸屬於母公司業主之權益報酬率」，教材另以 CIAS 代稱（不是通用縮寫）；0-2 簡化為 Profit÷E，介面加「簡化」標記。名稱與計分口徑待確認（T22）。
note.en: The template heading is return on equity attributable to owners of the parent, and the course also uses the non-standard abbreviation CIAS; the 0-2 slides simplify it to Profit over E with a simplified marker. The name and scoring basis are pending (T22).

definition.zh-TW: 股東投入的權益賺到多少獲利，是股東最關心的報酬率。數值越高表示股東的錢用得越有效率；杜邦分析把它拆成純益率、總資產週轉率與權益倍數。
definition.en: How much profit the shareholders' equity earns: the return shareholders care about most. Higher means their money works harder; the DuPont analysis splits it into net profit margin, total asset turnover and the equity multiplier.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
